$comment: Profile for the global /dependabot-sweep skill (~/.claude/skills/dependabot-sweep). Read by its verify.py; the notes are for whoever runs the sweep. Dependabot's own rules are in .github/dependabot.yml's header.

lockfile.why: package.json's packageManager, CI (oven-sh/setup-bun) and the server's Dockerfile pin Bun 1.4.2; bun.lock is lockfile v2, and another Bun can write another format that fails --frozen-lockfile there.

notes: Merging to main deploys both Dokploy apps (autoDeploy, by watch paths): sync-server (apps/server/**, packages/**, apps/addon/RoadToSixty/*.lua, package.json, bun.lock) and web-production (apps/web/**, packages/**, bun.lock, package.json, tsconfig.base.json). A bun.lock change redeploys both. The website's build args (PUBLIC_SITE_URL, PUBLIC_DOWNLOADS, PUBLIC_ADDON_URL) live in Dokploy, never in the repo.

The server migrates its database and starts the merge worker and pruning on startup (apps/server/src/index.ts), so it is build-only here. GitHub CI's server job runs its tests against Postgres and S3 and the image's smoke script (`bun apps/server/scripts/smoke.ts`, a merge under Lua 5.1 inside the image): wait for it green.

Tauri: its crates (apps/desktop, Cargo) and its @tauri-apps packages are pinned exactly and must match (tauri with @tauri-apps/api, each plugin with its JS half, @tauri-apps/cli on the same minor), or `tauri build` refuses. Bump both sides in one sweep. Majors by hand.

The desktop app can't be built on the box (Tauri needs a desktop toolchain on three systems): Cargo bumps rely on GitHub's Desktop CI (desktop-ci.yml, runs on pull requests touching apps/desktop or bun.lock). Wait for it green.

zip and minisign-verify (apps/desktop/engine) unpack and check the signature of the addon release the app downloads (src/addon.rs): read their release notes, and keep the signature checked before anything is unpacked. zip was pinned exactly at 4.6.1 with open alerts (fixed in 9.0.5) as of 2026-11-28.

better-auth and @better-auth/core are pinned to one exact version together (Battle.net sign-in, apps/server/src/auth.ts). After a bump, sign in with Battle.net on the deployed server and link a PC before calling it done: Deploy Forge's 1.7.28 made every auth request 500.
drizzle-orm / drizzle-kit: `cd apps/server && bunx drizzle-kit generate` must make no new migration. Never `push`.

Bun's own version (packageManager, CI, oven/bun in the server's and website's Dockerfiles), the website's nginx stable line (1.28) and the Rust toolchain (apps/desktop/rust-toolchain.toml) are moved by hand, not in a sweep. The test Postgres in apps/server/docker-compose.yml stays on production's major (sync-postgres is postgres:17).
The addon (apps/addon) has no dependencies; its pure Lua files (Packed, Tidy, Parse, Tally, Merge) run inside the server image under Lua 5.1.
No changelog note for a sweep: CHANGELOG.md is the addon's players' changelog.

steps.name: desktop-window-tests
steps.run: cd apps/desktop && bun test scripts src

sync-server.why: It migrates the production database and starts the merge worker and pruning on startup: a second copy would work on real journeys. GitHub CI's server job runs the image's smoke script instead.

web-production.why: Static pages served by nginx: no database, no secrets, nothing it writes.

smoke.label: an unknown page gets the 404 page
